verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Ollama has a pricing page and cloud API tiers (e.g., ollama-docs-17, ollama-docs-20) but never states the licensing terms for the core software (e.g., MIT license) or clarifies whether commercial/enterprise use of the community edition requires a paid subscription. Missing for 10: explicit license text (MIT/Apache), an FAQ or terms-of-use clarifying commercial use rights, and any enterprise agreement/SLA documentation.
